_comment: Demo seed for the on-chain registry. Badge ids are what the badge key shows (8-bit, two upper-case hex digits; the third digit on the badge screen is the CRC — id 27 shows 271, id 86 shows 86D, id 4A shows 4A6). `consent` is the initial on-chain state; flip it live on stage. Badges not listed here are auto-registered as opt_out by the service the first time a camera sees them. `contact` is the organizer's off-chain directory the notify service uses to tell an opted-out person they were filmed (name for the popup, `email` for the mailer, optional `phone` in E.164 for SMS once a transport exists) — it never goes on-chain. An email only sets the on-chain CHANNEL_EMAIL bit when it actually sends (EMAIL_MODE=send).
